notes: Feature 3 implements the Script Node MV world-description input/output interaction and API contract only.
The current Script Node input is a single AI chat-style world-view description.
The Script Node output expands that description into storyboard direction, character profiles, and concrete scene descriptions.
The current Script Node interaction binds one input composer under the selected Script node, and the AI response history appears between the node and input after AI修改 or generation.
Prompt wording is intentionally centralized and adjustable later without changing route or UI contracts.
Real provider credentials are supplied through environment variables; test fake provider remains the default verification path.
Storyboards as a separate editable node remain Feature 4.

small_features.title: Define shared Script Node contracts
small_features.user_visible_behavior: The Script Node has stable typed world-description input, structured output, task, and status shapes used by frontend and backend-facing code.
acceptance_criteria: Script input includes only world_description for the first MV world-view prompt.
Script output includes title, world_overview, storyboard_direction with POV and shots, characters with visual/wardrobe/body details, scene_descriptions, and missing_inputs.
Task status values remain compatible with the repository API contract.

Run shared/web tests that consume Script Node contracts.

small_features.title: Implement FastAPI Script Node API and test fake provider
small_features.user_visible_behavior: The Script Node can save input, create a generation task, and retrieve structured output through backend API routes.
acceptance_criteria: PATCH /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/nodes/{node_id} saves Script Node input and settings.
POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/nodes/{node_id}/run returns a task response and produces validated structured output through the test fake provider.
GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} and GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/result return task status and normalized Script Node output.
Provider provider configuration fails clearly when required env values are missing.
verification: Run backend pytest for validation, save, run, result, test fake output, and missing provider config.

small_features.title: Implement workspace Script Node editor
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Selecting the Script node opens an editor where users can enter an MV world prompt through the AI chat UI, run generation, and review structured results.
acceptance_criteria: The editor is reachable from the selected Script node in /workspace.
The editor includes one required AI chat-style MV world description input.
Run action saves input, starts generation through the Script Node API client, shows task state, and renders selectable Storyboard, Characters, and Scene response targets.
Output target selection stays in the input composer footer and shows Storyboard, Characters, and Scene names.
The response history appears between the Script node and the input composer after AI修改 or generation.
The Script Node does not use a detached floating editor or modal.
The Script node status changes to ready only after validated output exists.
Image, audio, video, persistence, and production auth gaps remain honestly labeled.
verification: Run focused workspace tests.

small_features.title: Hook Script Node text provider to OpenAI API
small_features.user_visible_behavior: When server env selects the OpenAI text provider and an API key is supplied, Script Node generation can call the configured OpenAI-compatible Responses API while the default test fake path remains available for local verification.
acceptance_criteria: The Script Node continues to use the generic ScriptProvider interface and returns the existing ScriptOutput contract.
TEXT_MODEL_PROVIDER=openai or openai-compatible calls the configured /responses endpoint with the configured text model.
OPENAI_API_KEY can be used as the shared credential fallback, so local setup only needs the key plus provider selection.
The OpenAI response text is parsed as JSON, including normal output_text, output content text, and fenced JSON output.
Text, image, video, and music model categories are documented in .env.example, but only text execution is implemented in this Feature 3 optimization.
Missing text provider credentials fail clearly without exposing secrets.

small_features.title: Implement backend-connected multi-turn Script AI dialogue
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can use AI modify on the selected Script node as a backend-connected multi-turn AI conversation, then use Generate when they want a structured ScriptOutput for downstream nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Shared frontend and backend contracts include Script dialogue messages, request, and response shapes.
POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/nodes/{node_id}/chat accepts current Script input, settings, prior history, and the latest user message, then returns an assistant message plus appended history.
Test fake provider returns deterministic conversational replies without external credentials.
OpenAI/openai-compatible provider can send dialogue prompts through the configured Responses API and return natural-language output text.
The workspace AI modify button calls the dialogue route and renders multiple user/assistant turns without replacing Generate's structured ScriptOutput task flow.
The Script node is marked ready only after structured generation output exists; chat alone does not pretend downstream media/persistence is complete.
Browser E2E verifies two visible AI dialogue turns in the open /workspace tab.

small_features.title: Complete AI chatbox and direct text outcome node
small_features.user_visible_behavior: When the user clicks Generate, the Script node shows a loading animation, creates or updates an editable Script outcome node on the canvas, and renders direct natural text there instead of placing generated output in the AI chatbox history. Node cards avoid repeated floating icon labels, and Script outcome content is a single editable text frame. If AI modify mode is active, Generate uses the conversation history as context; otherwise it uses the current world description directly. The current product path uses configured live providers only.
acceptance_criteria: Generate calls the backend direct text path instead of asking the model for structured JSON text.
Generate creates or updates one deterministic Script outcome node on the canvas.
The Script outcome node renders the returned text and allows local editing.
Generated output does not appear as an assistant reply in the AI chatbox history.
AI modify and Send remain conversational, and Generate uses dialogue history only when AI modify mode is active.
The UI and provider configuration expose only configured live provider paths, with automated tests using internal fake providers instead of product fallback providers.
The shared workflow output-node metadata can be reused for later AI nodes with different payload renderers.
Generate shows a visible loading animation while the backend direct-output request is running.
Workflow nodes do not repeat the same icon in a floating label above the card.
Script outcome content uses a single editable text frame without nested metadata boxes.
